description: This file defines a Vue store using Pinia to manage order-related state and operations in an online shopping system. It includes functions for creating orders, fetching user orders, fetching specific orders, retrieving all orders (admin), and updating order status.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order with the specified shipping address by calling the orders API and updates the store state.

methods.name: fetchUserOrders
methods.description: Fetches the current user's order history from the server and updates the store state.

methods.name: fetchOrderById
methods.description: Fetches a specific order by its ID and sets it as the current order.

methods.name: fetchAllOrders
methods.description: Fetches all orders (admin only) and updates the store state.

methods.name: updateOrderStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an order by its ID and reflects the change in store state.

ctags.name: err
ctags.pattern: /^      const err = e as { message?: string }$/
